lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Mark Carney and his European Union counterparts closed a major summit Friday by announcing what they called an ‘alliance for the future.’, The Canadian Press reports.
Ottawa lists Roberts Bank port expansion in B.C. as project of national interest, The Canadian Press reports.
‘Life-threatening experience’: Family releases statement following violent Bridle Path home invasion, The Canadian Press reports.
Early voting jumps across U.S. Senate battlegrounds as millions more Americans vote ahead of Election Day, The Canadian Press reports.
An ICE officer is charged with assault for striking a man with a car in Houston, The Associated Press reports.
Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
